title: Optimization Workshop Notes for Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints Algorithms: Penalty Interior-Point, Implicit-Programming, and Piecewise SQP
summary: In this workshop, we discuss several algorithms for mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints (MPECs). The unifying theme is that MPECs are optimization problems whose feasible set contains a lower-level equilibrium system, often written through complementarity or variational-inequality conditions. This destroys the smooth manifold or convex structure that standard nonlinear programming methods rely on.
